name: goal-kick-seq
reply:
What I saw
- Goal kick play-out scenario against an opposing 4-2-3-1 / 4-4-2 press block.
- Need to establish building out from the back with numerical superiority using the single pivot and split center-backs.

On the board
- Slide 1: GK distributes to split CBs with the single #6 dropping deep to create a numerical advantage against the press.
- Slide 2: Full-backs stretch high and wide to create maximal width in the build-up phase.
- Slide 3: Progression into the middle third through the central midfielder or wide passing lane as the opponent jumps.

Coaching points
- Split center-backs to the edges of the 18-yard box to stretch the first line of pressure.
- Drop the single pivot (#6) into the passing lane between or beside the center-backs to act as a secure outlet.
- Maintain high and wide positioning with full-backs so the ball-carrier always has a line-breaking option.

Sequence: 2 frames — Frame 1 is your saved board; later frames add the play. Use Play on the board to scrub.
